card.name: Hedging words before a possible outcome
card.fires_on: Small words such as will, may, be and to that sit right before a possible adverse outcome, in warnings about what might happen or is unknown.

modes.label: May / will before outcome
modes.description: A modal verb after a subject, leading into a possible reaction or risk.
modes.example: Symptoms such as these<< may>> be associated with an increased risk for suicidal

modes.label: Likely to / be prepared to
modes.description: The word to after likely or prepared, introducing a possible condition or event.
modes.example: it is not possible to predict which patients are likely<< to>> develop the syndrome.

modes.label: Unknown whether patients will
modes.description: The word will after whether such patients, in statements of uncertainty.
modes.example: because it is unknown whether such patients<< will>> be predisposed to these reactions with X

card.writes: It lowers Chinese words meaning 'may happen' and 'potentially', so it seems to dampen extra hedging about possibility.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a warning says something might happen, such as a reaction or a risk.
